patch_description: Replace the random, unoptimized sample with a deterministic multistart simulated-annealing constructor. The search evaluates all 286 triangle areas and normalizes them by the current convex-hull area, matching the primary metric directly. It uses a lower-tail mean as a secondary objective so that moves improving several nearly degenerate triples are preferred, rather than merely exchanging the active worst triangle. Ring-and-interior initializations provide a substantially better geometric starting distribution than uniform random points, while coordinate perturbations and occasional global shakes escape poor local arrangements. The best configuration is selected strictly by the primary normalized minimum-area criterion.
